sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's bind operator silently propagates Nothing through an entire chain of computations, so once absence appears, every subsequent step yields Nothing without ever being evaluated.
A static local variable persists across function calls — it survives the function's death and rebirth, carrying its value forward invisibly, never accessible from outside.
The 'never' return type indicates a function that cannot possibly return — the type system guarantees the caller will never receive a value back.
